mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are enjoying clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 66 degrees. With the moon in its first quarter, keep an eye out for the International Space Station, which will be visible for three minutes starting at 4:10 AM, rising from the southwest near Mount Horeb and moving toward the east northeast over the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The City of Verona is currently accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee infrastructure and utility projects until September 20th. Additionally, the city has implemented a rain barrel rebate program, offering a 30 dollar credit for qualifying installations, and residents should be aware of recent adjustments to sewer and stormwater utility rates to support essential city maintenance.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.
In our weekly police report, on Friday, August 15th, officers arrested a 29-year-old Verona man for a second offence O W I after a citizen reported his reckless driving.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is currently closed, but they will reopen at 10:00 AM today, so be sure to stop by then.
